In the last week I have visited the pharmacy 6 times before being able to obtain all the medication that had been ordered each time being told if you can call back tomorrow we will have the stock in , this didn't happen at one point I was told if you would like to wait 2hours until we have checked the delivery you can .
This morning on my 5th visit I was given what I thought was the remaining items only to find when delivering them to my clients that one item was missing , apparently it was in the fridge and the pharmacy assistant failed to include it with the order .
My clients who are housebound and pay £20 an hour for care services are seriously out of pocket this week due to the incompetence of Spilsby Doctors pharmacy.
I'm sure I'm not the only person who is so frustrated with the service provided as two people in the queue in front of me rolled their eyes and were clearly unhappy .
I've advised my clients who live 6 miles from Spilsby surgery to change to Horncastle GP as I know the service there is excellent.
I would have awarded zero stars for this review however the system doesn't allow this",null,[0,162]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sweWJqRjJjMDVyTUdsdVJHcHRVSHBKVmsxS2MwRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x72fc4b9b0e95c344!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOk0ybjF2c05rMGluRGptUHpJVk1Kc0E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2sweWJqRjJjMDVyTUdsdVJHcHRVSHBKVmsxS2MwRRAB&t=1&_xyKgswZGpLZHZLTWVxSA&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjE0Mnn1a-TAxVvRAkBHQB3D7MQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjE0Mnn1a-TAxVvRAkBHQB3D7MQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBUnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMHd3Vm04MGFGOWZSV2hETkhwNVNXSkdiWGd4VVRsc1NIcGFWVUZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VERCV2J6Um9SMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWWFYwTmhURVp4VG1Wak1EbHdjMkV5T1VkUGIyYxAB",["0x0:0x72fc4b9b0e95c344",null,1773590695010293,1773590695010293,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113888193855269558009/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Debra-Gail Oggelsby","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocL5fu8kbiEKX_NfsxmLt8KrCXLmbbDHFTisuQUIeWi454HpgA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113888193855269558009?hl=en"],"113888193855269558009",null,1,0,null,[0,1,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjE0Mnn1a-TAxVvRAkBHQB3D7MQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"5 days ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I cant
